pages.title: Strategic Continuity
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA EXECUTIVE BOARD$()$(br)Strategic Continuity Session 14-B$(br2)Recovered records show a pre-phase board packet distributed to only six seats.$(br2)The attendance list names Vale, Ren, Sato, Hollis, Kline, and a redacted security officer. Copies were meant to be returned to Records immediately after adjournment.

pages.title: Agenda Packet
pages.text: The packet is divided by $(italic)page$() and $(italic)agenda$() groupings rather than a single narrative memo.$(br2)Topics jump between board procedure, colonial holdings, atmospheric stabilization, security audits, geothermal dampers, and strategic continuity motions.$(br2)The structure feels more important than the prose.

pages.title: Directive 7-C
pages.text: The closing line forbids annotations in $(italic)non-archival ink$() under directive 7-C.$(br2)That warning does not read like a formality. It reads like someone expected the margins to matter.
